judge.what_is_spun: Digital/BPM business (Demerged Undertaking 1) into Digitide Solutions; infra services into Bluspring — a three-way demerger
judge.reason: "Not merely a corporate restructuring exercise. It was a deliberate recalibration to unlock long-term value" — simplified structure, greater management focus, independent strategies, enhanced capital allocation, operational efficiency.
judge.insiders: Entitlement is 1:1 mirror, so existing holdings carry across; promoter percentage not stated. Vested ESOPs transfer to resulting companies, unvested cancelled with fresh allotment. New CEOs/CFOs appointed per entity.
judge.hidden_value: Cost-of-acquisition split (Quess 41.71%, Digitide 26.47%, Bluspring 31.82%) implies most value sat outside staffing. Remaining Quess is debt-free, net cash ₹255 cr, adj. PAT +54%, ROE target 20%, 75%-of-FCF dividend policy.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Two unrelated industries (digital/BPM, infra services) dropped on staffing holders 1:1; chairman confirms "stock saw some weakness immediately following the demerger".
judge.listing_timeline: On April 01, 2025: "expected to commence trading on BSE & NSE in the next two months, subject to regulatory approvals"; on June 09, 2025: "Effective from Wednesday, June 11, 2025, the equity shares of Digitide Solutions Limited and Bluspring Enterprises Limited shall be listed and admitted to dealings on the Exchanges."
judge.read_next: Digitide's own listing documents and first standalone results — the demerged undertaking's pro-forma financials are not in these filings.

demerged_business_names: Tata Motors Limited (formerly TML Commercial Vehicles Limited)
judge.reason: Distinctive profile and established business model of the Commercial and Passenger Vehicles businesses makes them suitable to be housed in separately listed entities, allowing sharper strategic focus, greater agility, accountability and value unlocking through price discovery.
judge.insiders: Shareholding pattern of Resulting Company mirrors Demerged Company on Record Date, including common promoters (Tata Sons). Promoter group held 1,565,402,703 of 3,682,582,902 shares. P B Balaji (4,93,186 shares) sits on Tata Motors Limited's board.
judge.hidden_value: Cost-of-acquisition apportionment implies CV 31.15% and PV 68.85% of value. Parent retains Passenger Vehicles, EV business and JLR; India PV business is net cash (~Rs.5,000-7,000 Cr) while JLR carried ~Rs.33,000 Cr net debt. Separate listing enables price discovery and segment-specific investors.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Every TML holder got 1:1 CV shares; shares untradeable ~45-60 days from allotment (Oct 15) to listing (Nov 12), with price adjusted by exchange discovery.
judge.listing_timeline: On October 9, 2025 the Company said “The process of obtaining Listing and Trading permission generally takes 45-60 days from the date of filling necessary application with Stock Exchanges”; on November 10, 2025 it informed that TMCV “received approval from BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited for listing and trading of its equity shares, effective November 12, 2025.”

judge.reason: Risk and reward of the Pharmaceutical and Agrochemicals verticals are different; segregation enables focused growth, operational efficiency, different investor sets, enhances shareholder value and unlocks value of the business verticals

judge.selling_pressure_why: Tiny relative size (1.48% of turnover), different industry from pharmaceuticals, early growth stage, 1:1 share issue to all pharma holders

demerged_business_names: Soft Gelatine business of Strides Pharma Science Limited
Biologics CDMO business of the Company
judge.reason: To bring together the Soft Gelatine business of Strides Pharma Science Limited, Complex Injectables business of Steriscience and Biologics CDMO business of the Company to create OneSource, a multimodal pure-play specialty pharmaceutical CDMO.
judge.insiders: Arun Kumar is common Promoter and Non-Executive Director of OneSource and Strides, holding 0.85%; promoter/promoter group 29.77%. Neeraj Sharma, former Steriscience CEO, is OneSource CEO & MD.
judge.hidden_value: A pure-play CDMO holding Strides' softgels plus group injectables/biologics: FY25 standalone net worth Rs 59,108 million but accumulated losses to be set off against securities premium; goodwill and Rs 344m/quarter scheme-intangible amortisation mask cash earnings; net debt Rs 9,033 million; FY28 guidance $400m revenue, 40% EBITDA.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Shares were allotted to eligible Strides shareholders, some moved to Demat/Unclaimed Suspense Account; documents state no size, index exclusion or industry difference.
judge.listing_timeline: "the Company's equity shares were listed on NSE and BSE on January 24, 2025", following NCLT Mumbai order dated November 14, 2024 (certified copy received November 26, 2024) - stated in the AGM Notice filed August 29, 2025 (notice dated August 4, 2025).
judge.read_next: NCLT Mumbai order dated November 14, 2024 and the Scheme's share-entitlement ratio for Strides shareholders; plus FY25 annual report securities premium and accumulated losses.
judge.quote: On 25th September 2023, the Board of Directors of (1) OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited (formerly Stelis Biopharma Limited), (2)Strides Pharma Science Limited and (3) Steriscience Specialties Private Limited, approved a Scheme of Arrangement to bring together the Soft Gelatine business of Strides Pharma Science Limited, Complex Injectables business of Steriscience and Biologics CDMO business of the Company to create OneSource, a multimodal pure-play specialty pharmaceutical CDMO.

judge.what_is_spun: Green Mobility Business Undertaking of Refex Industries — technology-integrated clean-fuel passenger fleet services — demerged into Refex Mobility Limited
demerged_business_names: Refex EV Fleet Services Private Limited
judge.reason: Risk, competition, financial profiles and return ratios of Ash & Coal handling are distinct from Green Mobility; separate listing lets each attract different investors and unlocks value for stakeholders.
judge.insiders: Mirror shareholding: 1 RML share per RIL share, so promoter and promoter group hold 56.57% (7,76,23,085 shares) of RML; no new board/KMP; no interest except directorship/shareholding.
judge.hidden_value: Separation isolates a small loss-making unit (green mobility segment EBIT -₹3,823.51 lakhs FY26; ~₹220 crore net assets, ₹88.41 crore unsecured plus ₹64.92 crore secured creditors at RGML) from parent's high-margin Ash & Coal and wind businesses.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Demerged turnover ₹2,897.62 lakhs = 1.18% of post-merger RIL (stated 2.5% of revenue); loss-making, different industry, newly listed.
judge.listing_timeline: Not fixed; Aug 5, 2026 meeting noted RML shares "were proposed to be listed on BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited"; NSE (Mar 16, 2026) requires trading to commence "within sixty days of receipt of the order of the Hon'ble High Court/NCLT"; Oct 28, 2026: "NCLT hearings are underway... next hearing scheduled for 28 October 2026" with "proposed demerger awaiting final approval from the Hon'ble NCLT"; May 27, 2026 call guided "another 60 to 75 days" / ~90 days.
judge.read_next: NCLT sanction order and RML's abridged prospectus/Information Memorandum (Annexure 16B) for standalone mobility financials and net assets transferred.
judge.quote: The Green Mobility Business is capable of attracting a different set of investors, lenders, strategic partners and other stakeholders and have significant potential for growth and profitability.

judge.what_is_spun: Sugar Business: manufacturing, marketing, sale/distribution of white crystal sugar from sugarcane and allied products, demerged into PFEL
judge.reason: Separating Sugar Business gives both companies focused attention for growth and investment, better operating architecture and capital allocation, enhances shareholder value and unlocks value through price-discovery of individual entities; PAIL becomes pure-play alco-bev.
judge.insiders: No change in PAIL shareholding; PFEL's pre-scheme capital cancelled, no cash consideration; holders get 1 PFEL share per 9 PAIL shares, so promoters hold PFEL proportionately. Promoter percentage not stated.
judge.hidden_value: Sugar was 20.53% of FY26 turnover (Rs 233.05 cr) but a Rs 9.05 cr segment loss, with sugar segment liabilities Rs 221.67 cr versus assets Rs 105.54 cr. Parent left as pure-play alco-bev: Rs 908 cr revenue, ~31.5% EBITDA margin.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Tiny stub: 1 share per 9 held, ~20% of turnover, loss-making sugar in a different industry from the alco-bev story holders bought.
judge.listing_timeline: Press release April 28, 2026: demerger scheme filed with SEBI, "which expects completion by the end of FY27"; CFO on April 29, 2026 call: "we envisage to complete this process by FY '27 this year". NSE letter August 14, 2026: PFEL listing/trading must commence "within sixty days of receipt of the order of the Hon'ble High Court/NCLT".

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing separated; Sanghi Industries' cement business absorbed inbound into Ambuja, Sanghi dissolved without winding up
judge.reason: Not stated for Sanghi specifically; group schemes cite same line of business, complete ownership, synergies, streamlining multiple entities into a unified 'One Cement Platform' for long-term shareholder value
judge.insiders: No new entity. Ambuja promoter/promoter group held ~167.20 crore shares, 67.33% of paid-up capital, and voted 100% in favour of the schemes; Gautam S Adani chairs the Board. Sanghi promoter stake not stated
judge.hidden_value: Absorption of a laggard: only 12 Ambuja shares per 100 Sanghi shares, 1,29,93,708 shares issued (~0.5% dilution). Sanghi's 6.6 MTPA Sanghipuram plant ran ~57% cement utilisation; acquired assets dragged EBITDA (base assets Rs 1,189/t vs Rs 1,060 consol). Ambuja debt-free
judge.selling_pressure_why: Tiny issuance of 1,29,93,708 Ambuja shares (~0.5%); same cement industry and promoter; only fractional entitlements sold on-market by Catalyst Trusteeship
judge.listing_timeline: No listing of a demerged entity: Sanghi shares were "suspended from trading with effect from April 06, 2026"; Ambuja shares allotted April 10, 2026, and per the July 3, 2026 filing "trading in the equity shares so allotted commenced on June 30, 2026"

judge.reason: Creating a dedicated manufacturing vertical for focused attention, increased efficiencies, synergies, better resource allocation and de-risking; then amalgamating WPL's remaining business to consolidate ownership in one listed company
judge.insiders: Promoters held 75.00% of CWL pre-Scheme, 73.50% post-Scheme; CCPPL is CWL's wholly owned subsidiary; Rathod family MD/Joint MDs re-appointed to November 10, 2030; no cash consideration paid
judge.hidden_value: Nothing is actually set free: manufacturing stays inside CWL through wholly owned CCPPL and WPL is dissolved. It reveals WPL's manufacturing turnover of INR 342.84 crore (93.28% of WPL's FY24 sales) and a cash-rich remainder — assets INR 550.39 crore, net worth INR 511.75 crore
judge.selling_pressure_why: Only 46,53,239 new CWL shares to ex-WPL holders on a 22.08 crore base (~2%); no new listing, same industry, no index exclusion
judge.listing_timeline: Said November 12, 2024: 'The equity shares issued by the Company as consideration for the demerger will be listed on the stock exchanges on which the shares of the Company are listed i.e. the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.' judge.what_is_spun: Nothing is spun off: wholly owned subsidiary NCC Infrastructure Holdings Limited is amalgamated into parent NCC Limited.
judge.reason: Consolidation of businesses under one roof, simplified corporate structure, direct control of Transferor's assets, fewer legal entities, reduced managerial overlaps and duplication of systems, optimum resource utilisation, greater financial strength — resulting in enhanced shareholder value.
judge.insiders: No shares issued; Transferor wholly owned, its entire paid-up capital held by NCC stands cancelled, so promoter stake unchanged. Promoter family runs NCC: A A V Ranga Raju (MD), A G K Raju, A V N Raju.
judge.hidden_value: Reveals a dead holding vehicle, not a hidden business: income from operations Rs.48 lakhs, net loss Rs.33.54 crore FY24 and Rs.1.65 crore FY25, investments fully impaired Rs.62.05 crore, carried-forward tax losses Rs.58.63 crore, one unsecured creditor Rs.45 crore.
judge.selling_pressure_why: No new shares or listed entity; the wholly owned subsidiary is dissolved without winding up, so no distribution, index exclusion or forced selling.
judge.listing_timeline: not stated — no demerged entity is to be listed; on 5 February 2026 the Board approved "the Effective Date of the Scheme as 28th February 2026 (the date on which the Order would be filed with the Registrar of Companies, Hyderabad)", and "Upon the Scheme becoming effective, NCCIHL shall stand dissolved without being wound up."
judge.read_next: Scheme Exhibit-I (Petition pages 43-71), Clause 11 pooling-of-interest accounting, and NCCIHL's Rs.58,63,61,458 carried-forward tax losses per the Income Tax observations.
judge.quote: The Scheme involves the amalgamation of a wholly owned subsidiary Company, namely M/s.NCC Infrastructure Holdings Limited with its holding company M/s.NCC Limited, pursuant to Section 230 and 232 of the Companies Act, 2013, as spelt out in Part II of the Scheme.

confidence: the judge read the complete documents: nothing is separated — subsidiaries or another company are amalgamated

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing is spun off — all of ACC's cement and ready-mix concrete business amalgamates into Ambuja Cements
judge.reason: Both companies are in the same line of business; amalgamation gives Ambuja complete ownership, unifies manufacturing and commercial functions, streamlines the group structure, unlocks economies of scale, synergies and shareholder value
judge.insiders: Promoter/promoter group held 106,456,927 shares (56.69%) and voted 100% in favour; Ambuja, ACC's promoter, holds 50.05% and its ACC shares will be cancelled; ACC holders get 328 Ambuja shares per 100
judge.hidden_value: A debt-free ACC with Rs 20,680 Cr net worth, Rs 578 Cr cash and AAA/A1+ ratings, lending Rs 3,900 Cr of inter-corporate deposits to parent Ambuja at 8%, while reported EBITDA (7.0% margin, Rs 414/tonne) is depressed by higher MSA volumes with Ambuja
judge.selling_pressure_why: No new entity is distributed; ACC holders receive shares of larger, listed, same-industry Ambuja and ACC is dissolved
judge.listing_timeline: No new listing: ACC is dissolved without winding up and Ambuja issues new equity shares; 'completion is expected during FY'27' (press release dated October 27, 2026), 'expected to be completed during FY'27, subject to regulatory approvals' (press release dated July 24, 2026)
judge.read_next: The NCLT final sanction order in CA(CAA)/33(AHM)2026, and ACC's Rs 3,900 crore inter-corporate deposit to Ambuja
judge.quote: Following the strong support received from shareholders, the proposed merger of ACC with Ambuja Cements will now proceed to the NCLT for final sanction.

judge.what_is_spun: Not stated — no business is separated; entire Happiest Minds amalgamates by absorption into ITC Infotech India Limited
judge.reason: Creation of a single, globally credible platform combining complementary capabilities, customer relationships and talent pools; greater scale, synergies and cross-selling; US$1 billion annual revenue by FY28; India's 11th largest IT services player
judge.insiders: Ashok Soota and Ashok Soota Medical Research LLP sell 22.106% for ₹1,330 crore (~₹395/share average), with non-compete and non-solicit obligations; retain ~7.55–7.6% of combined entity, reclassified as public, not promoter; ITC Limited becomes promoter at ~73.4%
judge.hidden_value: Happiest Minds valued at 15.1x FY26 EBITDA (implied ₹405/share, ₹6,167 crore equity) versus ITC Infotech at 13.6x (~₹11,920 crore); promoter transacted at ~₹395, ₹10 below assessed value. Combined entity ₹18,087 crore, FY26 revenue ₹7,033 crore, ~18.1% adjusted EBITDA margin
judge.selling_pressure_why: Happiest Minds delists and is dissolved; holders get 25 ITC Infotech shares per 81; relisting only in Q2/Q3 FY28; public float ~26.6%
judge.listing_timeline: On the September 1, 2026 call: "These shares will then get listed on the BSE and NSE through a process established in this regard. Listing is expected in Q2/Q3 of FY28." The August 31, 2026 investor presentation places "Listing & Trading of new securities of combined entity" in Q2 & Q3 FY28, with the overall process taking up to ~15 months subject to approvals
judge.read_next: Draft Scheme of Amalgamation on happiestminds.com/investors, plus Slide 14 valuation framework and the August 31, 2026 PwC/Grant Thornton report
judge.quote: Post getting all the approvals from NCLT, we would be delisting Happiest Minds and merging Happiest Minds into ITC Infotech and then list the Company after that.

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing spun off — subsidiary Cavendish Industries Ltd's automotive tyres, tubes and flaps business absorbed into JK Tyre
judge.reason: Both companies in similar line of business; amalgamation houses all businesses in one listed company for economies of scale, operational synergies, reduced interest cost, combined distribution network, fewer compliances, enhanced shareholders' value
judge.insiders: Promoters 50.55% pre-scheme, 49.31% post (Sept 2024 filing). Nov 2025: promoter Bengal & Assam and promoter-group J.K. Fenner bought 40,00,000 CIL shares from JK Tornel for Rs.130.64 crore
judge.hidden_value: Reveals a turned-around asset absorbed on the cheap: CIL utilisation lifted from ~30% to over 95%, contributing 27.02% of consolidated income and 21.94% of net worth in FY25; restated FY25 PAT rises to Rs.674.73 crore; consolidated debt Rs.4,445 crore
judge.selling_pressure_why: Only 1,42,69,484 shares issued (capital Rs.54.80 to Rs.57.66 crore); listed in same industry, no index exclusion; fractional entitlements just 3 shares
judge.listing_timeline: Per 26 December 2025 allotment filing, the 1,42,69,484 shares allotted to CIL shareholders 'are proposed to be listed on BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited, where the existing Equity Shares of the Company are listed'; no separate demerged entity lists
judge.read_next: Q2 FY27 results — whether the 4-7% price hikes offset the 18-20% Q1 raw-material spike flagged 27 May 2026
judge.quote: The merger is expected to unlock substantial value through enhanced operational synergies, economies of scale, a stronger and bigger diversified product portfolio, and enhanced reach across a combined distribution network.

judge.what_is_spun: No business spun off; MCFL amalgamated into PPL, plus ZACL's Mahad granulated single super phosphate business acquired on slump sale
demerged_business_names: Zuari Agro Chemicals Limited (ZACL) granulated single super phosphate plant, Mahad, Maharashtra
judge.reason: Merger expanded capacity 23% to 3.7 million MT, unlocked new South India markets and drove economies of scale, procurement efficiency and product-mix synergies, making PPL pan-India
judge.insiders: Zuari Maroc Phosphates held 57.2% of PPL at 30 Sep 2025; promoters Zuari Agro and OCP; Akshay Poddar (son of Saroj Kumar Poddar) made Vice Chairman; MD Krishnan ex-MCFL MD & CEO
judge.hidden_value: Merger lifted capacity 23% to 3.7 MMT; FY26 PBT Rs 1,328 crore versus Rs 1,154 crore excluding the scheme; goodwill Rs 141.34 crore; net debt-to-equity 0.66x; FY26 operating cash flow negative Rs 1,012 crore
judge.selling_pressure_why: 22,16,23,331 new shares (~21% of enlarged 103.79 crore capital) issued to former MCFL holders, listed 30 December 2025
judge.listing_timeline: Stated 31 December 2025: "the Company has received the trading approval for 22,16,23,331 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- each ... from National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on December 30, 2025"; allotment was 3 December 2025, record date 31 October 2025
judge.read_next: Part III of the Scheme (effective 13 October 2025) covering the ZACL Mahad slump sale, and the final purchase price allocation note
judge.quote: The successful merger with Mangalore Chemicals & Fertilizers Ltd (MCFL) expanded PPL's capacity by 23% to 3.7 million MT, unlocking new markets in South India and driving economies of scale, procurement efficiency, and product -mix synergies.

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing is spun off; Silverleaf's HFT/technology business is absorbed into Share India by amalgamation
judge.reason: Business synergy, consolidation and pooling of resources into a single entity; valuable addition to the technology stack, additional product portfolio, diversifying revenue and expediting global expansion, adding value to shareholders
judge.insiders: Scheme states no change in management or Promoter/Promoter Group of the listed transferee; Silverleaf ESOS holders received 3,80,500 SISL ESOS-II options at Rs 2 exercise price, 1,41,500 already vested
judge.hidden_value: A technology/HFT business absorbed for only 44,02,000 new Rs 2 shares (~2% of 22.3 crore). Silverleaf earned Rs 6.69 crore PBT in FY24 but a Rs 41.41 lakh loss in FY25; management guided Rs 50-60 crore top line post-merger
judge.selling_pressure_why: No demerged entity distributed; only ~44 lakh new shares to Silverleaf's few unlisted holders, frozen till exchange trading permission
judge.option_pricing_date: March 18, 2024 (date of approval of the Scheme by the Board of Directors, as on which ESOS options and the Rs 10 exercise price are stated; restated as on August 5, 2024 and September 4, 2025)
judge.listing_timeline: not stated for any demerged entity; the Scheme says new equity shares 'shall be listed on all the Stock Exchanges on which the Equity Shares of the Transferee Company are listed as on the Effective Date' and 'will remain frozen in the depositories system till listing/trading permission is given by the Designated Stock Exchange' (certified Scheme filed October 27, 2026; Scheme effective November 3, 2026; 44,02,000 shares allotted November 4, 2026)

judge.reason: Both companies in the same line of business; amalgamation lets Ambuja assume complete ownership for long-term strategic alignment, combining operations for focused growth, operational efficiencies, synergies, economies of scale and a streamlined group structure.
judge.insiders: Ambuja, the promoter, holds 72.66% (14,92,92,730 shares) of Orient and voted 100% in favour; Ambuja's own promoter group holding goes 67.65% to 67.15% post-scheme.
judge.hidden_value: Exchange ratio 33 Ambuja shares (FV Rs.2) per 100 Orient shares (FV Re.1); Orient standalone FY25 revenue Rs.2,708.83cr, net worth Rs.1,807.91cr folding into Ambuja (consol revenue Rs.35,044.76cr, net worth Rs.63,811.42cr, debt-free, AAA rated); management says Orient operates at full capacity.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Only 1,85,35,158 new Ambuja shares issued; public holding rises 32.30% to 32.80% of a far larger listed cement peer.
judge.listing_timeline: not stated — no new listing; Orient's promoter and public holdings become "Nil" post-arrangement (disclosure dated December 22, 2025), with Ambuja shares issued "Upon the Scheme becoming effective"; shareholders approved September 28, 2026, NCLT sanction still pending
judge.read_next: The joint valuation report dated December 22, 2025 (GT/BDO) and SBI Caps fairness opinion justifying the 33:100 exchange ratio.

judge.listing_timeline: Not stated — "The equity shares of the Transferor Company are not listed on any Stock Exchanges" (Scheme, 10 March 2026); AP Polymers stood dissolved without winding up on the Effective Date of 31st March 2026
judge.read_next: Q1/Q2 FY27 gross margin versus 45.6% as VAE phase-1 commissions; management's quantification of backward-integration benefit

judge.hidden_value: Standalone news business is near-breakeven (FY25 EBITDA Rs 33 cr on Rs 1,896 cr revenue; pre-tax loss Rs 285 cr, finance costs Rs 213 cr, borrowings ~Rs 2,770 cr) while holding stakes revalued at Rs 3,498 cr exceptional gain — Viacom18/Star JV, BookMyShow 39.29%, Eenadu 24.5%.
judge.selling_pressure_why: 49,50,51,499 new shares (~32% of enlarged capital) issued to former TV18/E18 holders; trust sold consolidated fractional entitlements.
judge.listing_timeline: Said November 21, 2024: "The Equity Shares of the Company shall be admitted for trading on BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited effective November 22, 2024."; scheme effective October 3, 2024, allotment October 25, 2024
judge.read_next: Standalone balance sheet: carrying/fair value of Viacom18, BookMyShow and Eenadu stakes versus Rs 2,770 crore current borrowings.
judge.quote: Merger of TV18 and E18 with Network18 has created India's largest platform-agnostic news media powerhouse with the widest footprint across languages, straddling both TV and Digital.

judge.hidden_value: No security is created for shareholders. The four exited associates contributed only Rs 68.09 cr, 0.144% of FY24 consolidated income of Rs 46,913.12 cr, for Rs 506.63 cr cash; TBCB SPVs (80+) are being made leaner, not listed
judge.selling_pressure_why: No shares distributed, no new listing or index event; subsidiaries remain wholly owned and consolidated within POWERGRID
judge.listing_timeline: not stated; the Orders dated 02nd November 2026 state only that "the Schemes shall be active from the Second Day of November Two Thousand Twenty Six", and the 27th January 2026 Orders set an appointed date of 01st April 2024
judge.read_next: FY26 annual report / CERC-DIPAM approvals for the two transferee SPVs' standalone financials and tariff continuity post-merger
judge.quote: The proposed Merger/Amalgamation Schemes, envisages to consolidate the business for creation of larger unified entities and reduce the number of entities within the group to achieve operational and management efficiencies, and simplification of administrative tasks and have simplified organisational structure.

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing is spun off; Indosolar's solar photo-voltaic module manufacturing business is amalgamated into Waaree Energies
judge.reason: Simplify group structure, consolidate assets and liabilities, place cell and module manufacturing in one backward-integrated entity, end related-party cell supply and duplicate listed-entity compliance
judge.insiders: Indosolar promoters hold 74.93%, public 25.07%; Waaree promoters go from 64.12% pre-scheme to 63.91% post-scheme, public 35.88% to 36.09%
judge.hidden_value: Indosolar is small and dependent: assets Rs 404.92 cr, net worth Rs 323.63 cr, turnover Rs 68.36 cr, no cell capacity, versus Waaree net worth Rs 13,869.90 cr; only 9.48 lakh new shares issued
judge.selling_pressure_why: Indosolar public holders receive only 9,48,199 Waaree shares, about 0.33% of post-scheme capital, into a larger more liquid listed entity
judge.listing_timeline: No new listing: documents dated September 23-24, 2026 state the Scheme results in 'cessation of the separate listed entity obligations in relation to the Transferor Company' and that Indosolar 'shall be dissolved without being winding up'
judge.read_next: The draft Scheme of Amalgamation on www.waaree.com, with the joint share exchange ratio report and Emkay fairness opinion

judge.hidden_value: Transferor companies are tiny: PunjabExpo net worth Rs 771.77 lacs, Vahni negative Rs (168.63) lacs, income Rs 241.53/681.98 lacs versus TIL income Rs 5,27,259.58 lacs. Leverage visible: gross debt INR 2,295 crore, net debt INR 1,911 crore
judge.selling_pressure_why: No shares issued and no change in the shareholding pattern of the Company pursuant to the Scheme
judge.option_pricing_date: Relevant date for pricing equity shares and warrants: Monday, July 21, 2025
judge.listing_timeline: not stated — no new entity or listing; Appointed Date "April 1, 2026 or such other date as may be fixed or approved by the Hon'ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench" (filing dated May 29, 2026)

judge.read_next: Intimation confirming filing of the RD Order with Registrar of Companies, making the Scheme effective
judge.quote: Further, the Scheme of Amalgamation being an internal restructuring process, this order does not have any material impact on the business operations of the Company.

confidence: the judge read the complete documents: nothing is separated — subsidiaries or another company are amalgamated

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing is spun off; Indovida India (rigid PET packaging) is merged by absorption into listed EPL Limited
judge.reason: Wider product range for customers, geographical diversification, operational/financial efficiencies and cost synergies from pooled resources; creating a consumer packaging leader for emerging markets with ~$1 billion revenue
judge.insiders: Promoter/Promoter Group rises 25.97% to 68.37%; IVL becomes co-promoter with 51.8%, Blackstone (Epsilon) 16.6%; IVL nominates 3+ directors, Epsilon 1; Bakshi stays Group CEO
judge.hidden_value: EPL valued at INR 339/share, ~70% above Friday's close and 12.5x EBITDA, while Indovida at 8.1x — a ~35% discount; Indovida is net cash, 21.3% EBITDA margin, 23.7% ROCE, EPS accretive Day 1
judge.selling_pressure_why: Documents do not state; public shareholding falls from 74.03% to 31.63% as 18.5 crore new shares go to promoter IVL
judge.listing_timeline: No new listing: "EPL will continue as the listed entity"; closing "expected to close in the next ~12 months" (March 29, 2026 press release); CFO said "Q4 FY '27" (May 14, 2026 call); NCLT application filed October 23, 2026; observation letters valid six months from October 19, 2026
judge.read_next: The NCLT scheme explanatory statement: Indovida's 3-year Revenue/PAT/EBITDA, valuation report basis and post-merger balance sheet
judge.quote: The proposed transaction will be implemented through a scheme of amalgamation, pursuant to which Indovida will merge with EPL, and EPL will continue as the listed entity.

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing is spun off; wholly owned subsidiary Kia Health Tech is merged into parent Rubicon Research
judge.reason: Companies engaged in similar activities; amalgamation gives business synergy, pooling of resources, centralised economies, reduced multiplicity of legal and regulatory compliances, and augments Rubicon's manufacturing footprint
judge.insiders: Promoter and Promoter Group hold 98,828,360 of 165,531,908 shares and voted 100% in favour; no shares issued, no consideration, no change in shareholding or voting rights
judge.hidden_value: Kia has no operations and nil revenue (net worth ₹815.80 lakh at 31-Mar-2025) but is setting up a manufacturing plant at Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar; merger gives Rubicon unfettered access to cash flow and added capacity
judge.selling_pressure_why: No shares issued, no consideration payable, no change in shareholding pattern or voting rights of the listed parent
judge.listing_timeline: No new listing: scheme filed July 22, 2026 states 'On the Scheme becoming effective, the Transferor Company shall without any further act, instrument or deed shall stand dissolved without being wound-up'; Appointed Date April 1, 2026, and on November 14, 2026 the Company said the Regional Director returned the fast-track application and it is evaluating the regular NCLT process
judge.read_next: The Regional Director's order dated November 6, 2026 and whether Rubicon refiles via NCLT
judge.quote: The proposed amalgamation of the Transferor Company with the Transferee Company would result in business synergy and pooling of their resources into a single entity which would facilitate in exploiting the significant potential for growth.

judge.hidden_value: UFSL's 1,44,00,36,800 equity and 20,00,00,000 preference shares in the Bank were extinguished, cutting issued capital from Rs 2,159 crore to Rs 1,932 crore; the Bank became 100% public-owned, promoter-free
judge.selling_pressure_why: Documents record only 17,945 consolidated fractional shares sold at Rs 50; no index, size or industry-difference data stated
judge.listing_timeline: Not stated for any demerged entity; the May 6, 2024 allotment filing says the allotted shares rank pari passu and "the Bank will submit necessary applications for listing and trading approvals from the exchanges"
judge.read_next: Scheme clause 4.9.1 accounting treatment and the Bank's post-merger capital of Rs 19,31,79,51,170

judge.reason: Not stated in the scheme filings; management cites "synergies and integration benefits realised through this acquisition have created a meaningful value for the company" and Kurlon contributing to long-term growth and shareholder value
judge.insiders: Not stated; promoter stake undisclosed. KEL shareholders received 52 SFL shares per 100 held, 4,88,146 shares allotted. Rahul Gautam continues as CMD, Tushaar Gautam elevated to Vice-Chairman; SF ESOP-2022 options granted to employees
judge.hidden_value: Reveals Kurlon turnaround: ~Rs.250 crore synergies (Rs.190-200 crore realised), core EBITDA margin to 10.8% FY26, first-ever dividend, net debt cut Rs.156 crore, ROCE ~18% excluding intangibles, plus 34.53% Furlenco stake and land monetisation
judge.selling_pressure_why: Only 4,88,146 new SFL shares issued to KEL shareholders; no separate listed entity created; fractional entitlements consolidated and sold by Trust
judge.listing_timeline: Said on 22nd April, 2026: "the Company has received listing and trading approval from the BSE Limited (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) for the equity shares allotted pursuant to the Composite Scheme of Arrangement... These shares are available for trading effective April 22, 2026"; record date Friday, 30th January, 2026 and allotment approved February 03, 2026

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing separated: Gamooga Softtech (marketing automation, data analytics) merged into Karix Mobile, both Tanla subsidiaries — an internal consolidation, not a demerger
judge.reason: "to consolidate business operations, streamline the group structure, and achieve operational efficiencies. It is expected to enhance organizational capability and result in cost savings and compliance efficiency"
judge.insiders: Not stated for Karix; Karix is a wholly-owned subsidiary, Gamooga shares held by Karix stand cancelled, no change in Tanla's shareholding. Promoters hold 46.17% of Tanla post-buyback
judge.hidden_value: Karix turnover ₹2,333.87 crore vs Gamooga ₹46.19 crore. Group's Digital Platforms earns 98.4% gross margin, 78.4% EBITDA margin on ₹3,949 Mn FY26 revenue; cash ₹11,436 Mn; CEO: "we don't have any such plans" to split platforms
judge.selling_pressure_why: No shares issued, no cash consideration, no listing; "There is no change in the shareholding pattern of Tanla Platforms Limited"
judge.listing_timeline: not stated — no listing contemplated; Karix stays an unlisted wholly-owned subsidiary. "The Appointed Date of the said merger is April 1, 2025 and the Effective Date is November 27, 2025" (filing dated November 27, 2025)
judge.read_next: Karix standalone financials — ₹2,333.87 crore turnover as on March 31, 2025, versus Gamooga's ₹46.19 crore
judge.quote: The proposed merger of Gamooga Softtech Private Limited with Karix Mobile Private Limited aims to consolidate business operations, streamline the group structure, and achieve operational efficiencies.
